recordings.previousText: Theory runs out at this move. From here, judgment has to replace memory.
recordings.text: This move takes the game past our opening book. From here, each move earns its verdict on the board.
recordings.reason: The departure fires where our opening catalogue ends, not where theory, the known opening or preparation ends, and the game may have left the book before a transposition.

recordings.previousText: After the earlier setback, this move puts the position back on its feet. That is fighting back, and it counts.
recordings.text: After the earlier setback, the position is back on its feet. Now prove it can stay there.
recordings.reason: A move never raises its own evaluation; the opponent's moves made the game playable again, so the take no longer credits this move or the learner.

recordings.previousText: The back rank is weak, and this move lets the other side use it. The king's own pieces block its escape, and that is a route to mate.
recordings.text: The back rank is weak, and this move lets the other side use it. The king is shut in behind its own pieces, and that is a route to mate.
recordings.reason: A back-rank mate checks along the king's rank, so the square beside the king toward the checker is never blocked by an own piece; the take now says the king is boxed in behind its own pieces.
